Q.name: H-28G Evolution Turret
Q.title: Template:Data Heimerdinger/H-28G Evolution Turret
Q.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|H-28G Evolution Turret|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Heimerdinger
|skill        = Q
|icon         = H-28G Evolution Turret.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Heimerdinger}} deploys a rapid-fire turret that deals {{as|magic damage}} to his target, or a nearby enemy. The turret will become dormant while he leaves it alone.
|blurb2       = '''Heimerdinger''' periodically [[stocks]] a ''Turret Kit'', up to a maximum of 3.
|blurb3       = The turret has a secondary beam attack that charges up over time, which deals {{as|magic damage}} to enemies hit.
|post-blurb   = Heimerdinger/H-28Q Apex Turret
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Heimerdinger''' deploys a ''H-28G Evolution Turret'' at the target location, which lasts until destroyed.
|description2 = '''Heimerdinger''' periodically [[stocks]] a ''Turret Kit'' charge, up to a maximum of 3.
|description3 = Up to 3 ''H-28G Evolution Turrets'' can be deployed at a time, with those deployed beyond the maximum destroying the oldest one.
|description4 = ''See [[Heimerdinger#Pets|Pets]] for more details about H-28G Evolution Turrets.''
|cost         = 20
|costtype     = Mana + 1 Turret Kit
|cooldown     = 1
|recharge     = 20
|target range = {{tt|350|Turret deployment range}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = magic
|spellshield  = False
|spelleffects = special
|projectile   = True
|parry        = True
|callforhelp  = True
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|outofrange   = walk to location
|notes        = 
* The ''H-28G Evolution Turret's'' stats update every second to reflect rank ups, level ups, and changes in '''Heimerdinger's''' ability power.
* The ''Turret Kit'' buff will visually represent the recharge rate cooldown, and how many ''H-28G Evolution Turret's'' that '''Heimerdinger''' has stored. This is visible to both allies and enemies.
* The recharge rate of ''H-28G Evolution Turret'' is affected by [[ability haste]].
* The ''H-28G Evolution Turret'' has a {{tip|sight}} radius of {{tt|585|650*0.9}} while active and {{tt|{{fd|227.5}}|650*0.35}} while dormant.
* The amount of ''Turret Kit'' charges '''Heimerdinger''' has is indicated by small nuts orbiting him.
}}

-->{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|Hextech Micro-Rockets|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Heimerdinger
|skill        = W
|icon         = Hextech Micro-Rockets.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Heimerdinger}} fires a wave of rockets that converge to the target location and fan beyond it to max range, each dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy hit. Enemies take less damage from subsequent rockets that hit them.
|blurb2       = Whenever a rocket hits an enemy {{tip|champion}}, nearby {{ai|H-28G Evolution Turret|Heimerdinger|icononly=true}}{{ai|H-28Q Apex Turret|Heimerdinger|turrets}} gain some beam charge.
|post-blurb   = Heimerdinger/Hextech Rocket Swarm
|description  = {{sbc|Active:}} '''Heimerdinger''' launches a wave of 5 rockets that converge upon the target location and fan beyond it up to a maximum range, with each one dealing {{as|magic damage}} to the first enemy it hits. Every rocket hitting an enemy {{tip|champion}} grants 20% beam charge to all ''{{ai|H-28G Evolution Turret|Heimerdinger|icononly=yes}} {{ai|H-28Q Apex Turret|Heimerdinger|turrets}}'' within 1000 range, up to a maximum of 100% beam charge when hitting 5 rockets on an enemy champion.
|leveling     = {{st|Initial Rocket Magic Damage|{{ap|{{#var:w_ib1}} to {{#var:w_ib5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:w_iap}}% AP)}}}}
|description2 = Enemies can be hit by multiple rockets, but receive less damage from ones beyond the first. Against {{tip|minions}}, this lesser damage is increased by {{ap|({{#var:w_minionmod}}-1)*100}}%.
|leveling2    = {{st|Subsequent Rocket Magic Damage|{{ap|{{#var:w_sb1}} to {{#var:w_sb5}}}} {{as|(+ {{#var:w_sap}}% AP)}}|Total Subsequent Non-Minion Damage|{{ap|4*{{#var:w_sb1}} to 4*{{#var:w_sb5}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4*{{#var:w_sap}}}}% AP)}}|Combined Total Non-Minion Damage|{{ap|{{#var:w_ib1}}+4*{{#var:w_sb1}} to {{#var:w_ib5}}+4*{{#var:w_sb5}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:w_iap}}+4*{{#var:w_sap}}}}% AP)}}}}
{{st|Subsequent Rocket Minion Damage|{{ap|{{#var:w_sb1}}*{{#var:w_minionmod}} to {{#var:w_sb5}}*{{#var:w_minionmod}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:w_sap}}*{{#var:w_minionmod}}}}% AP)}}|Total Subsequent Minion Damage|{{ap|4*{{#var:w_sb1}}*{{#var:w_minionmod}} to 4*{{#var:w_sb5}}*{{#var:w_minionmod}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|4*{{#var:w_sap}}*{{#var:w_minionmod}}}}% AP)}}|Combined Total Minion Damage|{{ap|{{#var:w_ib1}}+4*{{#var:w_sb1}}*{{#var:w_minionmod}} to {{#var:w_ib5}}+4*{{#var:w_sb5}}*{{#var:w_minionmod}}}} {{as|(+ {{ap|{{#var:w_iap}}+4*{{#var:w_sap}}*{{#var:w_minionmod}}}}% AP)}}}}
|cooldown     = {{ap|11 to 7}}
|cast time    = {{fd|0.25}}
|target range = {{tt|1150|Total range is 1350, starting from 200 units behind Heimerdinger}}
|cost         = {{ap|50 to 90}}
|costtype     = Mana
|targeting    = Location
|affects      = Enemies
|damagetype   = Magic
|spellshield  = True
|spelleffects = spellaoe
|projectile   = True
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|outofrange   = cast at max
|notes        = 
* If casting beyond 1000 units based off current Heimerdinger's position, every rockets aim towards Heimerdinger's position extended towards cast position by 1100 units
* ''Hextech Micro-Rockets' '' direction-targeting allows for custom spread.
{{Effect at cast time end}}
}}

R.name: UPGRADE!!!
R.title: Template:Data Heimerdinger/UPGRADE!!!
R.wikitext:
{{{{{1<noinclude>|Ability data</noinclude>}}}|UPGRADE!!!|{{{2|}}}|{{{3|}}}|{{{4|}}}|{{{5|}}}
|champion     = Heimerdinger
|skill        = R
|icon         = UPGRADE!!!.png
|blurb        = {{sbc|Active:}} {{ci|Heimerdinger}} can empower his next ability to apply an additional effect. These empowered abilities have the same {{sti|cooldowns}} as their basic forms, deal modified damage, and do not cost mana.
|blurb2      = ''UPGRADE!!!'' can be recast after a short time, and does so automatically upon casting another ability.
|blurb3       = {{sbc|Recast:}} ''UPGRADE!!!'' ends and is put on a short {{sti|cooldown}}.
|description  = {{sbc|Toggle:}} '''Heimerdinger''' empowers his next [[champion ability|basic ability]] for an additional effect, consuming the empowerment upon cast and placing ''UPGRADE!!!'' on full cooldown. These empowered abilities have the same cooldowns as their basic forms, deal modified damage, and do not have a {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} cost.
|description2 = ''UPGRADE!!!'' incurs its static cooldown on-cast, and can be toggled off to remove the empowerment and place the ability on its static {{sti|cooldown}}.
|description3 = ''UPGRADE!!! can be used while affected by {{tip|cast-inhibiting crowd control}}.''
|cooldown     = {{ap|100 to 70}}
|cdstart      = Starts after using an empowered ability
|static       = 3
|cost         = 100
|costtype     = Mana
|cast time = none
|targeting    = Auto
|affects      = Self
|damagetype   = 
|spellshield  = 
|spelleffects = 
|projectile   =
|grounded     = 
|knockdown    = 
|notes        = 
*Toggled abilities do not count as ability activations for the purposes of on-cast effects such as {{tip|Spellblade}} and triggering {{ais|Force Pulse|Kassadin}} passive.
**Consuming the buff for an empowered basic [[Champion ability|ability]] does.
* No compensations for {{sti|{{as|mana}}}} are made if ''UPGRADE!!!'' is toggled off; '''Heimerdinger''' will lose {{as|100 mana}} each time he toggles the ability on and off.
}}
